summary: Completed public-backend and responsive UI testing for the New Product and Create New Collection flow. Draft preservation, validation, collection selection, product linkage, count increment, cancel behavior, and mobile overflow all passed.
action_items: Consider adding backend validation that collection_id references an existing collection before accepting a product. This edge was not part of the executed flow.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed collection and product records through the public API for linkage verification; they remain in the preview database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core collection-enhanced product flow verified at mobile viewport; desktop visual pass and invalid collection_id behavior remain optional follow-up coverage.
rca of the issue: No reproducible issue found. The UI stores the product draft in sessionStorage before navigation, merges the created collection id on return, and the backend increments product_count after product insertion.
